matter_background.original: There are 4 parties in a Deed of partition of a property in Tangalle to be executed before a Notary who has a license to Practise in Colombo. One party to the deed of partition resides in Tangalle and is unable to come to Colombo. However, the other three parties are residing in Colombo.

questions.source_quote:
(i) There are 4 parties in a Deed of partition of a property in Tangalle to be executed before a
Notary who has a license to Practise in Colombo. One party to the deed of partition resides
in Tangalle and is unable to come to Colombo. However, the other three parties are residing
in Colombo. Discuss as to how all parties can sign the said Deed of partition.
